mentions.name: Smartmap
mentions.description: An open-source app similar to the local-history-on-a-map concept, built almost a year ago during the holidays, with a mobile app version the author uses from time to time when going on walking adventures around the city.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Built something similar almost a year ago during the holidays [1]. Open-source if you want to check it out [2]. I use the mobile app version from time to time when I'm going on walking adventures around the city.

[1] https://smartmap.ai
[2] https://github.com/space0blaster/smartmap
